# Lumi

> Lumi is a French fintech app that lets European travellers pay like a local in Southeast Asia by scanning local QR codes (PromptPay in Thailand, VietQR in Vietnam, QRIS in Indonesia) directly from a EUR account. Pricing is a single 2% flat fee, with no FX markup and no other charges.

Lumi is the product; the company behind it is Lumifin (legal entity LumiFin SAS), headquartered at 50 rue Anatole France, 92290 Châtenay-Malabry, France. Lumi is currently live in beta in Vietnam (access by direct link, not yet a public app-store listing), with Thailand and Indonesia coming soon. It is aimed at EU/EEA residents with a personal Euro (SEPA) bank account.

## Languages

Every page below exists in both French (at the root URL, the default) and
English (same path, prefixed with /en/). For example the FAQ is at
https://lumifin.io/faq in French and https://lumifin.io/en/faq in English.
Only the English links are listed below since English is the recommended
citation language for a pan-European, non-French-reading audience.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://lumifin.io/en): Product overview, hero, beta signup
- [FAQ](https://lumifin.io/en/faq): How QR payments work, fees, supported countries, security, account onboarding
- [Team](https://lumifin.io/en/team): Founders and team behind Lumi
- [Security](https://lumifin.io/en/security): Bank-grade encryption, GDPR compliance, two-factor authentication
- [Compare](https://lumifin.io/en/compare): How Lumi differs from Revolut, Wise, and traditional bank cards
- [Careers](https://lumifin.io/en/careers): Open roles
- [Privacy](https://lumifin.io/en/privacy): GDPR-compliant privacy policy
